table_description: General Information - Return name, return code, reporting institution, bank code, address, reporting period, frequency, audit/validation status, bank category and tool/version details.

qa_pairs.question: Show the general information section of the annual RAQ return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT * FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO)

qa_pairs.question: What bank code is reported in the CIMS RAQ annual return general info?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Bank Code' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO)

qa_pairs.question: Get the reporting period and frequency from the annual return header
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO WHERE DESCRIPTION IN ('Reporting Period','Frequency') AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO)

qa_pairs.question: List all general info key-value pairs for a given bank and reporting date
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO)

qa_pairs.question: What is the return name and return code for CIMS RAQ Annual?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO WHERE DESCRIPTION IN ('Return Name','Return Code') AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO)

qa_pairs.question: Fetch the bank category and audit/validation status of the annual return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO WHERE DESCRIPTION IN ('Bank Category','Audit Status','Validation Status') AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_GEN_INFO)

table_description: Authorised Signatory - Name, designation, mobile no., landline no., e-mail id, place and date of the authorised signatory.

qa_pairs.question: Who is the authorised signatory for the annual RAQ return?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Name' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO)

qa_pairs.question: Show the designation and email id of the signatory
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO WHERE DESCRIPTION IN ('Designation','E-mail ID') AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO)

qa_pairs.question: Get mobile and landline number of the authorised signatory for a bank
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO WHERE DESCRIPTION IN ('Mobile No','Landline No') AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO)

qa_pairs.question: What place and date was the annual return signed at?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO WHERE DESCRIPTION IN ('Place','Date') AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO)

qa_pairs.question: List all signatory information fields for the annual return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT * FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SIGN_INFO)

table_description: Section 1: Portfolio Analysis (By delinquency in Interest Payment). Part A - Loans and Advances - including bill credit - Domestic Operations.

columns.column_description: Cash Credits, Overdrafts and Demand Loans

qa_pairs.question: Show domestic loans and advances by delinquency period for the annual return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, TOTAL_LOAN_ASSETS FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM)

qa_pairs.question: What is the total loan assets figure for domestic operations under Section 1 Part A?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT SUM(TOTAL_LOAN_ASSETS) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM)

qa_pairs.question: Get term loans and cash credit/overdraft amounts by delinquency bucket, domestic portfolio
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, TERM_LOAN, CASH_CR_OVERDRAFT_DEMAND_LOAN FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM)

qa_pairs.question: List bills purchased and discounted for domestic loans and advances portfolio
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, BILLS_PURCHASE_DISCOUNT FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM)

qa_pairs.question: How much loans and advances to banks are overdue in the domestic portfolio analysis section?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, LOAN_ADVANCE_BANK FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM WHERE PERIOD_DELINQUENCY != 'Current' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_A_DOM)

table_description: Section 1: Portfolio Analysis (By delinquency in Interest Payment). Part B - Other Interest Bearing Assets (OIBA) - Domestic Operations.

qa_pairs.question: Show Other Interest Bearing Assets (OIBA) by delinquency period for domestic operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, TOTAL_OIBA FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM)

qa_pairs.question: What is the commercial paper exposure under OIBA domestic in the annual return?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, COMMERCIAL_PAPER FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM)

qa_pairs.question: Get inter-bank assets and lease receivables from Section 1 Part B
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT INTER_BANK_ASSETS, LEASE_EASE_RECEIVABLE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM)

qa_pairs.question: Total OIBA for the current period, domestic operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT TOTAL_OIBA FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM WHERE PERIOD_DELINQUENCY = 'Current' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM)

qa_pairs.question: List notes and bonds of corporates held as OIBA, domestic portfolio
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, NOTE_BONDS_CORPORATE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_B_DOM)

table_description: Section 1: Portfolio Analysis. Footnote - Government paper excluded from OIBA Part B 'Current' row (Treasury Bills, GOI Securities, State Govt securities) with total.

qa_pairs.question: What government paper is excluded from OIBA current row in the annual return?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_EXC_GOVT_PAPER WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_EXC_GOVT_PAPER)

qa_pairs.question: Show Treasury Bills and GOI Securities excluded from Section 1 OIBA
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_EXC_GOVT_PAPER WHERE DESCRIPTION IN ('Treasury Bills','GOI Securities') AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_EXC_GOVT_PAPER)

qa_pairs.question: Get total government paper excluded from OIBA for a bank
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_EXC_GOVT_PAPER WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Total' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_EXC_GOVT_PAPER)

qa_pairs.question: List state government securities excluded from OIBA current row
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT VALUE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_EXC_GOVT_PAPER WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'State Govt. Securities' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_EXC_GOVT_PAPER)

table_description: Section 1: Portfolio Analysis (By delinquency in Interest Payment). Part C - Loans and Advances - including bill credit - Overseas Operations.

columns.column_description: Cash Credits, Overdrafts and Demand Loans

qa_pairs.question: Show overseas loans and advances by delinquency period, annual return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, TOTAL_LOAN_ASSETS FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_C_O WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_C_O)

qa_pairs.question: What is the total loan assets for overseas operations under Section 1 Part C?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT SUM(TOTAL_LOAN_ASSETS) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_C_O WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_C_O)

qa_pairs.question: Get term loans overdue beyond current for overseas portfolio
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, TERM_LOAN FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_C_O WHERE PERIOD_DELINQUENCY != 'Current' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_C_O)

qa_pairs.question: List bills purchased and discounted for overseas loans
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT BILLS_PURCHASE_DISCOUNT FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_C_O WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_C_O)

table_description: Section 1: Portfolio Analysis (By delinquency in Interest Payment). Part D - Other Interest Bearing Assets (OIBA) - Overseas Operations.

qa_pairs.question: Show OIBA for overseas operations by delinquency period
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT PERIOD_DELINQUENCY, TOTAL_OIBA FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_D_O WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_D_O)

qa_pairs.question: What is the commercial paper and inter-bank assets under overseas OIBA?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT COMMERCIAL_PAPER, INTER_BANK_ASSETS FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_D_O WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_D_O)

qa_pairs.question: Total OIBA overseas operations for current reporting period
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT TOTAL_OIBA FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_D_O WHERE PERIOD_DELINQUENCY = 'Current' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_D_O)

qa_pairs.question: List notes and bonds of corporates in overseas OIBA portfolio
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT NOTE_BONDS_CORPORATE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_D_O WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC1_PART_D_O)

table_description: Section 2: Classification of Risk Assets (By degree of risk and value impairment). Part A - Loans & Advances (including Bill Credit), Domestic and Overseas Operations.

columns.column_description: Provision made for possible losses (Domestic Operations)
Provision made for possible losses (Overseas Operations)

qa_pairs.question: Show classification of risk assets by risk category for the annual return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT RISK_CATEGORY, OUTSTANDING_AMT_DOM, OUTSTANDING_AMT_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: What is the outstanding amount and provision made for NPA risk category, domestic operations?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT OUTSTANDING_AMT_DOM, PROVISION_MADE_LOSSES_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A WHERE RISK_CATEGORY = 'NPA' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: Get the percentage to total loans for each risk category, overseas operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT RISK_CATEGORY, PER_TO_TOTAL_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: List provisions made for possible losses across all risk categories
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT RISK_CATEGORY, PROVISION_MADE_LOSSES_DOM, PROVISION_MADE_LOSSES_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: Total standard assets outstanding, domestic vs overseas operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT OUTSTANDING_AMT_DOM, OUTSTANDING_AMT_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A WHERE RISK_CATEGORY = 'Standard' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A)

table_description: Section 2: Classification of Risk Assets. Part A NPA breakup - Netting Items for NPAs and Net NPAs, Domestic and Overseas Operations outstanding amounts.

qa_pairs.question: Show netting items for NPAs and net NPA amounts for the annual return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT RISK_CATEGORY, OUTSTANDING_AMT_DOM, OUTSTANDING_AMT_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_NPA WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_NPA)

qa_pairs.question: What is the net NPA outstanding for domestic operations?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT OUTSTANDING_AMT_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_NPA WHERE RISK_CATEGORY = 'Net NPA' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_NPA)

qa_pairs.question: Get netting items reducing gross NPA, overseas operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT RISK_CATEGORY, OUTSTANDING_AMT_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_NPA WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_NPA)

table_description: Section 2: Classification of Risk Assets. Part A Memorandum items - loans/advances to Government or carrying Government guarantee which are non-performing, and interest not recognised thereon.

qa_pairs.question: Show memorandum items for government guaranteed non-performing advances
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT MEMORANDUM_ITEM, OUTSTANDING_AMT_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_MEMO WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_MEMO)

qa_pairs.question: What is the interest not recognised on government guaranteed NPAs, overseas operations?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT OUTSTANDING_AMT_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_MEMO WHERE MEMORANDUM_ITEM LIKE '%Interest not recognised%' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_MEMO)

qa_pairs.question: List memorandum items for loans to government carrying government guarantee
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT MEMORANDUM_ITEM, OUTSTANDING_AMT_DOM, OUTSTANDING_AMT_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_MEMO WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_A_MEMO)

table_description: Section 2: Classification of Risk Assets. Part C - Other Risk Assets and Exposures (on-balance sheet items 1-5 and off-balance sheet items 6-8), Domestic and Overseas Operations, classified by Standard/Sub-Standard/Doubtful/Loss.

qa_pairs.question: Show other risk assets and off-balance sheet exposures classified by asset quality
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT ITEM, TOTAL_DOM, TOTAL_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_C WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_C)

qa_pairs.question: What is the doubtful classification amount for off-balance sheet items, domestic operations?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT ITEM, DOUBTFUL_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_C WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_C)

qa_pairs.question: Get standard vs loss classification for each other risk asset item, overseas operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT ITEM, STANDARD_O, LOSS_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_C WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_C)

qa_pairs.question: List sub-standard other risk assets for both domestic and overseas operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT ITEM, SUBSTANDARD_DOM, SUBSTANDARD_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_C WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC2_PART_C)

table_description: Section 3: Restructuring of Advances. Part A - Restructuring of Advances by Category (Standard, Sub-standard, Doubtful, Loss), reporting number of borrowers, amount and sacrifice on diminution, for Domestic and Overseas Operations.

Item (Number of borrowers / Amount / Sacrifice on diminution)

qa_pairs.question: Show restructured advances by category for the annual return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT CATEGORY, DESCRIPTION, OUT_ACC_RES_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: How many restructured standard accounts slipped to NPA during the year, domestic operations?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT CATEGORY, ACC_SLIP_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A WHERE CATEGORY = 'Standard' AND DESCRIPTION = 'Number of borrowers' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: Get amount restructured through CDR mechanism, domestic and overseas
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT ACC_RES_CDR_DOM, ACC_RES_CDR_OS FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Amount' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: What is the outstanding restructured advances amount at year end for sub-standard category?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT OUT_ACC_RES_DOM, OUT_ACC_RES_OS FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A WHERE CATEGORY = 'Sub-standard' AND DESCRIPTION = 'Amount' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: List sacrifice on diminution in fair value for restructured loans by category
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT CATEGORY, ACC_RES_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Sacrifice on diminution' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_A)

table_description: Section 3: Restructuring of Advances. Part B - movement of restructured standard loans and advances (Domestic, Overseas and Global).

columns.column_description: Movement of Restructured Standard Loans and Advances

qa_pairs.question: Show movement of restructured standard loans and advances for the year
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT MOVEMENT_RESTRUCTURE_STD_LA, GLOBAL FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_B WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_B)

qa_pairs.question: What is the opening balance of restructured standard advances, domestic operations?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DOMESTIC FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_B WHERE MOVEMENT_RESTRUCTURE_STD_LA = 'Opening Balance' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_B)

qa_pairs.question: Get fresh restructuring during the year added to standard restructured advances, global
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT GLOBAL FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_B WHERE MOVEMENT_RESTRUCTURE_STD_LA LIKE '%Fresh restructuring%' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_B)

qa_pairs.question: List closing balance of restructured standard loans, overseas operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT OVERSEAS FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_B WHERE MOVEMENT_RESTRUCTURE_STD_LA = 'Closing Balance' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC3_PART_B)

table_description: Section 4: Change in Asset Quality Profile and Recoveries of NPAs. Part A - Movement in Loans and Advances during the period (during the year), Domestic and Overseas Operations.

qa_pairs.question: Show movement in loans and advances during the year by asset classification
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT MOVEMENT_FROM, TOTAL_DOM, TOTAL_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_A WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: What loans moved from standard to sub-standard, domestic operations, during the year?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT SUBSTANDARD_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_A WHERE MOVEMENT_FROM = 'Standard' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: Get doubtful loans movement for overseas operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT MOVEMENT_FROM, DOUBTFUL_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_A WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_A)

qa_pairs.question: List loss classification totals across domestic and overseas operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT LOSS_DOM, LOSS_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_A WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_A)

table_description: Section 4: Change in Asset Quality Profile and Recoveries of NPAs. Part B - Change in NPAs Profile during the Period (during the year), by asset classification, Domestic and Overseas Operations.

qa_pairs.question: Show change in NPA profile during the year for the annual return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT MOVEMENT_FROM, TOTAL_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_B WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_B)

qa_pairs.question: What is the closing balance of doubtful NPAs, domestic operations?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DOUBTFUL_DOM FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_B WHERE MOVEMENT_FROM = 'Closing Balance' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_B)

qa_pairs.question: Get fresh accretion to NPAs during the year, overseas operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT SUBSTANDARD_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_B WHERE MOVEMENT_FROM LIKE '%Additions%' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_B)

qa_pairs.question: List total NPAs by classification, domestic and overseas
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT MOVEMENT_FROM, TOTAL_DOM, TOTAL_O FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_B WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_B)

table_description: Section 4: Change in Asset Quality Profile and Recoveries of NPAs. Part C - Movement in Technical/Prudential Write-offs/Advances under Collection Account during the Period (during the year), Domestic, Overseas and Global.

qa_pairs.question: Show movement in technical/prudential write-offs during the year
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, GLODAL FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_C WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_C)

qa_pairs.question: What is the opening balance of technical write-offs, domestic operations?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DOMESTIC FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_C WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Opening Balance' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_C)

qa_pairs.question: Get recoveries made against technical write-offs during the year, overseas
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT OVERSEAS FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_C WHERE DESCRIPTION LIKE '%Recoveries%' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_C)

qa_pairs.question: List closing balance of advances under collection account, global operations
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT GLODAL FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_C WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Closing Balance' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_C)

table_description: Section 4: Change in Asset Quality Profile and Recoveries of NPAs. Part D - Recoveries of NPAs through SARFAESI, DRT and Lok Adalat (Position as at end of the Year) - Domestic Operations, reporting number of cases and amount.

qa_pairs.question: Show recoveries of NPAs through SARFAESI, DRT and Lok Adalat for the annual return
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, NO_OF_CASE, AMOUNT FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_D WHERE RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_D)

qa_pairs.question: How many cases and what amount was recovered through SARFAESI during the year?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT NO_OF_CASE, AMOUNT FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_D WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'SARFAESI' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_D)

qa_pairs.question: What amount was recovered through Lok Adalat, domestic operations?
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT AMOUNT FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_D WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Lok Adalat' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_D)

qa_pairs.question: Get number of DRT recovery cases for the year
qa_pairs.sql: SELECT NO_OF_CASE FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_D WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'DRT' AND RDATE = (SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_M_SEC4_PART_D)

table_description: Section 5: Top Defaulters (Global Operations). Top Impaired Credits - detail of each defaulter including PAN, name, date of sanction, risk classification and exposure/provision amounts.

qa_pairs.question: Show the top impaired credits / top defaulters list for the annual return
